TGO.note: Only a property census, not a population census or household survey.

facts.fact: LoGRI says Togo's tax authority OTR has digitalised property census taking, with tablets and geolocation mapping, to build an up-to-date land and fiscal cadastre, while most of the country has no cadastre.
facts.system: OTR property census and fiscal cadastre

systems.system: OTR property census and fiscal cadastre

TGO.note: Document states nothing on local government office connections.
The central tax authority identifies, bills and collects property tax and shares revenue with municipalities; no municipal revenue record stated.
